# postinstall

> shell scripts that turn a fresh debian 13 vps into a known-good box: user,
> ssh, nftables, fail2ban, sysctl, updates, tools, docker, cloudflare tunnel,
> dotfiles. idempotent, config driven, with a read-only audit.

target is debian 13 (trixie) only. bash 5, systemd, apt; the ssh decoy uses
system python and Debian's python3-paramiko. no build step or ci. isolated
decoy protocol checks live in tests/; target dependencies stay on target hosts.

## start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/extencil/postinstall/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the contract for llms and harnesses, module map, recipes, gotchas.
- [README.md](https://github.com/extencil/postinstall/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quick start, config surface.
- [config/postinstall.env.example](https://github.com/extencil/postinstall/blob/main/config/postinstall.env.example): every knob and its default.
- [docs/](https://github.com/extencil/postinstall/blob/main/docs/README.md): topic index.
- [docs/debian-13.md](https://github.com/extencil/postinstall/blob/main/docs/debian-13.md): trixie specific behavior.

## layout

- `debian13-postinstall.sh`: entrypoint, flags, module runner.
- `lib/common.sh`: logging, `run`, `write_file`, package install, backups.
- `lib/modules/*.sh`: one module per topic, sourced in fixed order.
- `audit/debian13-audit.sh`: read-only checks, exit 1 on failure.
- `docs/`: reasoning, failure modes, recovery.
- `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `.cursor/rules/`: thin pointers to AGENTS.md.

## invariants

- flags > config file > environment > defaults.
- idempotent, non-interactive, backups under `/var/backups/postinstall`.
- mutations only via `run()`; managed files only via `write_file`.
- a state-changing module needs an audit check in the same change.
- ssh: key only, no root login, lockout guard must never be weakened.
- no tokens or real addresses in the repo.

## verify

```bash
bash -n debian13-postinstall.sh
shellcheck -x debian13-postinstall.sh lib/common.sh lib/modules/*.sh audit/*.sh
bash debian13-postinstall.sh --list
bash audit/debian13-audit.sh --no-color
```

full `--dry-run` and any real run only on a disposable debian 13 host.
